title: Marble Mortar and Pestle Set Green 2.5" Inches Handmade Garlic Crusher & Grinder Bowl for Kitchen Mortar and Pestle Set - Herb Grinder Spice Grinder
description:
About this item
WHAT IS INCLUDED - 1 x Mortar & Pestle. Comes along with RADICALn branded secure and fragile packaging.
MATERIAL - It is made of High Quality Natural Marble so the color may vary sometimes.
SIZE - Mortar 2.5'' Inches & Pestle 2.5'' Inches
EASY TO CLEAN - Wipe it with a damp cloth and it will be as shiny as new again.
reviews_5s:
Perfect for what I need it for, grabs almost any substance to a fine dust and it's beautiful look fits in perfect in my kitchen. I love the marble and with so many color choices it was hard to choose. Would buy again.Got this as a gift to use on saffron and it works well! It's really cute and was made very well. I'm sure it will stand the test of timeCute, compact, has enough weight it doesn’t tip over.So I love this piece, but it is actually more of a decorative piece than usable. I mean, it will work great to crush pills, but otherwise, not food. It is very cute.Small.It is very small, perfect for crushing pills, which is what I needed it for. It is well made, very pretty and serves it's purpose.After buying a few others, and sending them back, I finally got the one I really love! This one is excellent!This is an elegant yet sturdy pill/spice grinder of flawless construction. I bought two, one in the green onyx, and one of the black marble. I am buying another one in the black marble. I also bought from this same company, RADICALn, two small shaving bowls. Since they are perfect, I am buying more of them. I use them as cat food bowls!The Radicaln Mortar and Pestle Set in Green Onyx is both stunning and highly functional! The craftsmanship is exceptional, with the natural green onyx adding a luxurious touch to my kitchen. It’s a beautiful piece that doubles as decor when not in use.

The set is sturdy and well-balanced, making it easy to grind spices, herbs, and even tougher ingredients like garlic and seeds. The smooth surface is easy to clean, and it doesn’t absorb odors or stains.

If you’re looking for a durable and elegant mortar and pestle, this set is a perfect choice. Highly recommend it for anyone who loves cooking or wants a gorgeous kitchen accessory!Such a pretty little thing. Could use this as just decor it's so pretty. Also it functions well. Almost too small to be useful but just big enough to work.
reviews_1s:
This is maybe large enough to grind up 2 medicine tablets but I'm returning it because I can't think of a single use for this except in a dollhouse. Should have measured but assumed it was some reasonable size.This item is so cute i loved it when I got it however within a day the pestle broke. I used it barely twice to grind cardamon for tea. I am so dissappointed. Its too delicate andthe only ergonomic flaw is the pestle is small to be able to hold while grinding confortably.As cute and dainty this mortar and pestle is. It is almost impossible to finely grind anything down to a fine powder. The bottom is flat, it should not be flat. It should be deep like a bowl, and there should never ever be edges in a mortar. The pestle can’t even get to the wall to grind anything. It just flings it around and you’re stuck mashing. If you do try to grind it’ll take you a half hour or longer to do something that should take not even a few minutes. I suggest a design change so that the bottom is more rounded out and deep and not flat, and that there are no edges because it creates a problem and is very frustrating.complete garbage, it broke almost right away
it looks fancy and nice but is poorly made for its use as a grinder as it split in half almost cutting my hand holding itVery pretty but it was absolutely useless for my purposes. The whole idea of a mortar and pestle obviously is to easily grind something into a fine powder but the grinding power comes from the unfinished surfaces rubbing against each other. Both pieces in this set are smoothly polished all over which defeats the purpose. I tried grinding a small pill with a shiny surface and all it did was cause the tablet to bounce around and nothing else. Maybe it would work on pills with an unglazed surface or possibility the pill I was trying to pulverize was too small or too hard. At any rate it was useless and did nothing. It is very pretty and the natural stone is obviously genuine but I guess I’ll have to get more details if I try to buy a different setTERRIBLE. Does not crush pills (for my mom) evenly and smoothly. The pestle doesn't seem to fit the mortar! It has areas that her medicine collects in, and she needs all of it crushed evenly. Really disappointed in this.What a joke!! Haven’t even had this 2 months only using to crush pills for my mom and already broke and chipped!! What trash!Poor quality control, A damaged mortar/pestle was shipped. It was packaged well but the bowl portion had a large gouge likely a manufacturing defect in it. I’m trying to return instead of exchange because the item will not work for me since not smooth and their QC is not goodIt looked good at first. But within 2 usages it got broken. Very disappointed with the quality. It's been only 10 days since I started using it. Would like to return ,unfortunately I don't have the original packing with me.I highly dislike the size
